question: Which of the following kings of Vijayanagara took the title of ‘establisher of the Yavana kingdom’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna Deva Raya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Krishna Deva Raya** was one of the most prominent rulers of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• He ruled from 1509 to 1529 and is known for his military, administrative, and cultural achievements.
 
• He took the title of 'establisher of the Yavana kingdom' after his successful campaigns against the Decca
